title: Deciding Amalgamation Beyond Arity Two: The Semantic Horn Case
summary: We study the amalgamation decision problem (ADP): given a universal first-order sentence $Φ$, decide whether the class $\mathrm{fm}(Φ)$ of its finite models has the amalgamation property. We call $Φ$ semantic Horn if $\mathrm{fm}(Φ)$ is closed under binary direct products. By McKinsey's theorem, this is equivalent to $Φ$ being logically equivalent to a universal Horn sentence. The distinction concerns the input representation: $Φ$ itself need not be given in Horn form, and converting it into an explicit Horn normal form can incur an exponential blow-up. We prove that the ADP is decidable…
